Delivery and returns FAQ

Everything below applies to orders placed on this website and shipped within the United Kingdom.

How long does delivery take?

Standard delivery arrives in three to five working days. Orders placed before 1pm on a working day are dispatched the same afternoon from the Leeds workshop, and you receive a tracking link by email as soon as the carrier scans the parcel.

Can I return a made-to-measure piece?

Made-to-measure work is cut to your dimensions, so it falls outside the standard fourteen day return window. If a piece arrives damaged or does not match the specification you approved, we will repair or remake it at no cost to you.

Do you deliver outside the United Kingdom?

We ship to the Republic of Ireland and to mainland Europe. Duties and import taxes are calculated at checkout and are payable by the customer on delivery.

What happens if nobody is home?

The carrier attempts delivery twice and then holds the parcel at the nearest collection point for seven days. You can rearrange delivery from the tracking link at any point before that window closes.
